## Improvements

- Download and install updates from the bottom-left corner of the usage window. The footer version and its release-notes pop-up have been removed; version information and release notes remain in **Settings → About**.

## Fixes

- Update installation now matches the version offered and the selected release channel, even when a different update was downloaded earlier.
- Changes to service-status monitoring, the Codex Spark card, and automatic updates are no longer lost when another setting is still saving.
- Codex usage remains available when its response contains an unknown reset time or numbers formatted as text.
- Limit warnings work again in a new usage cycle when the reset happened during a failed refresh.
- Problems first detected while notifications are paused no longer produce unexpected recovery or resolution messages after resuming.
- Disabled providers no longer send notifications from refreshes that were already in progress.
- Claude falls back to its signed-in CLI when the usage API returns an empty response or an unexpected response format.
